The exact named ALS estate HKCOLO at number 2 matches the operator address. Nearby MEGA Plus is the separate 299 Wan Po Road host (303.5 m between selected locators); MEGA IDC is separately identified on government lot TKOTL 131 (419.3 m). Global Switch is at number 18 Chun Yat Street (687.3 m), a separately returned ALS suggestion expressly excluded. Distances screen neighbours and do not establish property boundaries. CCC is one host; its rooms, cable landing facilities and exchange presences are not new sites.
